name: corpus
description: Find the original source behind information and carry selected context into later work.

interface.shortDescription: Find original sources and carry context forward
interface.longDescription: Corpus finds the original file, message, or completed AI task behind information used in your work, then keeps selected context linked to those sources for later tasks. Registered files and provider records remain unchanged; indexes and saved context stay on this Mac. Archived contexts remain readable, and permanent deletion is not available.
capabilities: Selected views without private source links
defaultPrompt: Show my registered collections, indexing coverage, and reusable context.
Find the original sources and passages I need for this task.
Continue this selected context and show what changed since the last review.
